custom_expected:
Step 4: Reassignment succeeds..
Step 6: Users column shows 0.
Step 7: Confirmation dialog appears (not Cannot Delete modal). After confirm, role is deleted.
custom_preconds: 'QA Delete Blocked' has exactly 1 user assigned.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings sidebar > Staff. Locate the user assigned to 'QA Delete Blocked'.
2. Open the user's role selector.
3. Change the user's role to a different one (e.g., 'Technician').
4. Save.
5. Return to Settings sidebar > Roles & Permissions.
6. On 'QA Delete Blocked' row, verify Users column now reads '0'.
7. Click the three-dot menu > Delete. Confirm.
title: After reassigning the assigned user(s), the role can be deleted
